releases.notes:
![Changes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e537df1f97d41414990e9287cffffbecc6ce9e22.png)
- **Big update to the Sharkos portion of the mod.**
  - **Sharko Armor were regiven effects. However, you need to wear the full set to have the effects.**
  - **Gave Sharko armor a custom model.**
  - **Retextured Sharko Cloths.**
  - **Added item info on each Cloth stating that the recipe for crafting the first type of Cloth is given out upon joining a world for the first time.**
    - **Funny enough, to try and stop people from killing Sharkos I had already implemented difficulties to punish players who did so. That shoulda been a sign from the beginning to not kill them!**
  - **Albino Sharko Armor now acts like regular Sharko Armor as Albino Sharkos and Sharkos are the same type of entity.**
  - **New recipes for Sharko Cloth.**
  - **Added new Sharko Cloth.**
  - **Added new Sharko Armor Sets.**
  - **Due to how easy it was to craft Regular Sharko Cloth, I have changed the recipe to require 4 blue dye, 4 string, and 1 leather.**
  - **Added TONS of recipes related to Sharko Armor.**
  - **Upcoming: Sharko Tool Sets.**
- **Added Strength effects for some armor to make the mod more balanced.**
  - **Max strength level is 25 for main portion armor. (Cosmic Tier+ Also, xEngie Tier is technically the start of Dark Matter Tier.)**
- **Removed Angry Engie - Hostile Engie armor eye textures so the said armor doesn't look goofy with certain skins and models.**
- **Changed Biblically Accurate Engie armor(all variants) to have the same design of Angry Engie - Hostile Engie armor of all variants.**
- **Removed some armor that used to be for All About Engie only as there's newer armor for Me, Contributors, and all Testers to obtain.**
  - **Content Creator armor will stay of course. Its obtainability is ran under a command now.**
- **Added a recipe to smelt Rotten Flesh into Leather in furnaces.**

![Fixes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ccab62feebd72ed74e3fa24e7e67cc661caab448.png)
- **Fixed a naming issue causing Mad Engie Tools and Armor to have similar names as Engie tools and armor.**
  - **PLEASE BACK UP YOUR WORLDS AS THIS CAN CAUSE ITEMS TO DISAPPEAR OR GIVE YOU BETTER GEAR AS REGISTRY NAMES HAVE BEEN CHANGED!**
- **Fixed being unable to upgrade from EngieGames tools and armor to Antimatter Mad Engie tools and armor with Antimatter Mad Engie Blocks.**
- **Fixed being able to upgrade Mindscape tools and armor to Antimatter Mad Engie tools and armor.**
- **Fixed regular coin blocks not showing up in the creative menu.**
- **Fixed a lot of armor advancements being somewhat vague.**
- **Fixed some advancements being hidden if not completed.**
- **Fixed some spelling mistakes with advancements.**
  - **You may have to reobtain these advancements because I also had to change their registry names.**
- **Fixed being able to smith Mindscape Engie armor to Antimatter Mad Engie armor.**
- **Fixed being unable to enchant Pickaxes and AIOTs with Engie's Blessing, Engie's True Blessing, Engie's Antimatter Blessing, and Engie's Dark Matter Blessing.**

![Reminder!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/128832adf5e69b4e39b5e2bf6594206cc5e4fb4e.png)
- **IF YOU FIND ISSUES, PLEASE REPORT THEM ON THE [GITHUB](https://github.com/DevEngieGames/EngiesChaos-and-EngieLib)! // [GitHub Issues Page](https://github.com/DevEngieGames/EngiesChaos-and-EngieLib)**
- **There is an official resource pack for the mod that can be downloaded from [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/engies-chaos-unobstructive-weapons) or [here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/engies-chaos-unobstructive-weapons)!**
